title: Build the incremental scan-state store
description:
Build the incremental re-scan state store at the cache dir (default XDG cache, overridable via --cache-dir): per JSONL file watermarks (path, size, mtime, linesSeen) so appended lines are read only once; per SQLite DB watermarks (dbPath, mtime, size, max seen createdAt) with a small overlap margin; full rescan when a file shrinks or its identity changes. The store persists watermarks, fingerprints, and counts only — never message text.

Done when: append-then-rescan produces totals identical to a cold scan (idempotence property test); rewritten files trigger a full rescan; state contents are verified text-free by test.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Implemented `src/sentiment/scan-state.ts`: per-JSONL watermarks (size/mtime/linesSeen, append resume, full rescan on shrink), per-DB watermarks with 60s createdAt overlap margin, XDG default cache dir (DATAPARADE_CACHE_DIR/--cache-dir override later at CLI). State file holds watermarks/fingerprints only; test asserts no message text persists. Outcome: green.
